phases.name: Adaptation & Load Management
phases.focus: Re-establish technical lifts with pregnancy-safe modifications and submaximal loading

phases.name: Strength Development (Submaximal)
phases.focus: Progress compound strength with conservative intensity, emphasis on posterior chain and pelvic stability

phases.name: Strength Maintenance & Durability
phases.focus: Maintain strength, increase movement variety, prioritize breathing/positioning and readiness for late pregnancy

non_negotiables: OB cleared for moderate strength (follow medical clearance)
Avoid Valsalva that produces dizziness or excessive breath-holding; prioritize controlled breathing
Progress loads conservatively; stop or lower load with any dizziness, bleeding, sharp pain, leakage, or unusual fetal movement changes

stage2.text:
PLAN "Prenatal 12-week Strength for Advanced Lifter"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public
GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Maintain and progress submaximal strength, preserve muscle mass and pelvic stability during pregnancy"
PHASES
  PHASE "Adaptation & Load Management" (3 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Lower training 50m "Lower heavy (submaximal)":
        warmup:
          bike 5m
          hip_circles 2m
          ankle_circles 1m
          bodyweight_squat 3m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          trap_bar_deadlift 3x6 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          split_squat 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 4m
          quad_stretch 3m
      DAY Upper training 50m "Upper heavy (submaximal)":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
          arm_circles 2m
          scapular_retraction 2m
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_press 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          seated_row 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lateral_raise 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 3x15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 3m
          shoulder_stretch 3m
      DAY Active recovery training 35m "Active recovery & core + pelvic floor":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3m
        main straight_sets:
          pelvic_tilt 3x12 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
          bird_dog 3x10 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
          side_plank 3x20s rpe 6 rest 30 seconds
          dead_bug 3x12 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 4m
          hip_flexor_stretch 3m
      DAY Full-body training 45m "Full-body metabolic strength (controlled)":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 3m
          leg_swings 2m
          inchworm 2m
        main straight_sets:
          kettlebell_swing 4x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          step_up 3x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          seated_calf_raise 3x15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          upright_row 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
